results.title: Senior Director: Mobility Planner
results.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description **Join a Landmark Giga-Project Shaping the Future of Saudi Arabia** Our client is delivering one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious and high-profile giga-projects, set to redefine global standards in destination development, innovation, and visitor experience. As part of the integrated Delivery Partner team, you will play a key role in planning, designing, and implementing world-class assets and infrastructure that support the Kingdom’s Vision 2030. This is a unique opportunity to contribute to a pioneering program at scale, working alongside industry-leading experts, cutting-edge technologies, and diverse stakeholders. If you are driven by challenge, motivated by impact, and eager to be part of a legacy project that will influence generations to come, we invite you to consider joining this transformative journey. The Senior Director: Mobility Planner is the ultimate technical, operational, and strategic authority responsible for the end-to-end planning, efficiency, and day-to-day management of the city’s multi-modal mobility network. With a mandate requiring extensive distinguished leadership experience, this executive-level leader oversees the live operations of the entire transportation ecosystem. This includes public transit systems, autonomous shuttle corridors, active mobility trails, parking networks, micro-mobility, and intelligent traffic management systems. Sitting firmly within the O&M division, this role focuses on maximizing network throughput, minimizing congestion, deploying next-generation smart-city mobility technologies, and ensuring safe, seamless, and sustainable journeys for millions of annual residents and visitors. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Network & Transit Operations (O&M) Direct the daily operations, transit scheduling, and fleet management of all public and private transportation systems, including buses, light rail/monorail, micro-mobility, and autonomous mass transit networks. Oversee the strategic implementation of active mobility frameworks, managing pedestrian corridors, bike networks, and scooter-sharing infrastructure to ensure perfect connectivity between major city hubs and entertainment districts. Serve as the principal authority for high-footfall event transport planning, designing mega-crowd traffic diversion models, park-and-ride strategies, and flexible transit surges to handle peak visitor loads seamlessly. Formulate robust emergency transportation plans, network redundancy routes, and incident-response protocols to guarantee zero-disruption mobility during grid failures or civil emergencies. Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) & Traffic Engineering Direct the operational deployment and tuning of the city's Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including adaptive traffic signals, automated speed enforcement, and real-time transit information displays. Partner with the digital city operations hub to leverage real-time traffic flow telemetry, predictive AI congestion mapping, and IoT sensor loops to optimize vehicle movements city-wide. Act as the technical authority for the city's smart car parks, integrating automated parking guidance systems (PGS), automated billing, license plate recognition (LPR), and electric vehicle (EV) charging grids with the broader mobility network. Financial Cost Recovery & Asset Integration Translate multi-modal usage logs, public transit ticketing data, and shared mobility fees into automated financial models for corporate finance teams. Provide the Service Charge Director with audited transit-wear metrics to ensure equitable infrastructure cross-charging, charging commercial zones, theme parks, and venues their fair share for the mobility infrastructure feeding their districts. Collaborate with the Asset Lifecycle Planning (LCP) division to map out multi-decade Capital Asset Replacement Plans (CARP) for core mobility infrastructure (e.g., transit fleets, smart charging arrays, signals, and ITS servers). Partner with the SAP-EAMS team to ensure every vehicle, charging dock, traffic sensor, and transit station is assigned a flawless digital ID for data-driven, predictive maintenance scheduling. Stage-Gate Handover & Design Advisory Serve as the primary mobility gatekeeper on the Stage-Gate Handover Committee, auditing traffic impact assessments (TIAs) and multi-modal readiness before newly constructed transit corridors or roads transition into live city operations. Formulate rigorous testing and commissioning verification rules for all transit fleets and smart ITS software networks prior to full operational adoption from builders and vendors. Job Requirements & Qualifications Education & Professional Credentials Bachelor’s Degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Design, Traffic Engineering, or a highly relevant quantitative technical discipline from an accredited institution. Master’s Degree in Transportation Engineering, Smart Mobility, Urban Planning, or an MBA from a globally recognized institution is highly preferred. Professional Certifications: Active senior professional registration, such as a Chartered Engineer (CEng), Professional Engineer (PE), or certification from the American Institute of Certified Planners (AICP) / Institute of Transportation Engineers (ITE). Experience 25+ years of progressive, distinguished leadership experience in multi-modal urban transit planning, large-scale traffic engineering, or smart city mobility operations. At least 8 years in a senior executive or director-level capacity, directly managing multi-disciplinary transport teams and multi-million-dollar mobility operational and capital budgets (OPEX/CAPEX). Proven track record of spearheading the operational setup, network routing, or post-construction integration of giga-scale mass transit networks, autonomous vehicle testbeds, or smart-city traffic frameworks. Deep experience navigating micro-mobility logistics, fleet electrification challenges, demand-side traffic management, and Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 sustainability and smart city targets. Technical & Soft Skills Deep technical command over macro and micro traffic simulation modeling software (e.g., PTV VISSIM, VISUM, Synchro, or equivalent platforms). Executive-level fluency in transport operational technologies, including fleet telematics, automated fare collection (AFC) engines, and SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAMS) integrations. results.title: Transportation Supervisor
results.description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Transport Supervisor to oversee and coordinate daily transportation operations between the Distribution Center (DC) and assigned dark store locations across Kuwait . The role will be responsible for ensuring the timely and efficient movement of goods from the DC to dark stores, managing delivery routes and schedules, overseeing truck fleet operations and utilization , monitoring driver performance, and maintaining high standards of operational efficiency and service quality. The Transport Supervisor will also be responsible for route planning and optimization, delivery allocation, truck fleet management, vehicle utilization and availability, driver coordination, transportation performance tracking, and managing operational issues and delays . The role will work closely with DC and dark store teams to ensure smooth and reliable replenishment operations, minimize delivery delays, optimize transportation resources, and ensure that dark stores receive the required inventory on time. Key Responsibilities Manage daily transportation operations from the Distribution Center (DC) to assigned dark store locations , ensuring timely, safe, and efficient movement of goods and smooth execution of replenishment plans. Plan, coordinate, and optimize transport routes, delivery schedules, truck allocation, and delivery capacity based on business requirements, store demand, and operational priorities. Manage and monitor the truck fleet , including vehicle availability, utilization, deployment, maintenance coordination, and overall fleet efficiency. Coordinate and supervise drivers and transport teams , ensuring adherence to delivery schedules, assigned routes, operational procedures, safety requirements, and service standards. Monitor daily transportation performance and key KPIs, including on-time delivery, route efficiency, vehicle utilization, delivery turnaround time, transportation costs, and service quality . Track deliveries in real time, identify delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and other transportation exceptions, and take timely corrective actions to minimize operational disruptions. Coordinate closely with DC, dark store, warehouse, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure accurate loading, dispatch, receiving, and timely replenishment of dark stores. Identify, investigate, and resolve transportation-related operational issues and delivery exceptions, conducting root-cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions. Analyze transportation data and operational trends to identify opportunities for route optimization, fleet utilization, cost reduction, and process improvement . Ensure compliance with company transportation policies, fleet safety standards, vehicle requirements, driver procedures, and applicable local regulations . Oversee the training and development of drivers and transport team members, ensuring they have the required operational knowledge, safety awareness, and service standards. Prepare regular transportation performance reports and provide data-driven insights and recommendations to management on fleet performance, route efficiency, operational issues, and improvement opportunities. Support the development and continuous optimization of transportation processes, route planning, fleet management, and DC-to-dark-store delivery operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and overall service quality. Job Requirements Bachelor's degree or higher in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration , or a related field; alternatively, 3+ years of relevant experience in transport, logistics, or delivery operations . Proven experience in delivery, transport, logistics, fleet, preferably within a fast-paced e-commerce or delivery environment. Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and identify performance improvement opportunities. Strong execution and follow-up skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a fast-paced environment. Good project management and process improvement capabilities. Fluent in English , with strong written and verbal communication skills. Willingness to be based in Kuwait and work according to operational requirements, including flexible working hours when necessary.

results.title: Logistics & Fleet Analyst
results.description: Job Summary We are looking for a Logistics & Fleet Analyst to support our day-to-day transportation, fleet, driver, Sales invoices, and logistics operations. The role will be responsible for monitoring fleet performance, coordinating trucks and drivers, analyzing logistics costs, Sales invoices , maintaining accurate records, and supporting efficient delivery operations. Key Responsibilities Coordinate daily Sales Invoices / truck and driver allocation based on delivery requirements. Monitor truck utilization, delivery schedules, routes, and vehicle availability. Coordinate with Warehouse, Sales, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries. Monitor driver attendance, trips, working hours, and performance. Maintain accurate fleet, driver, vehicle, and delivery records. Track fuel consumption, maintenance, repair costs, and other fleet-related expenses. Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly fleet and logistics performance reports. Analyze transportation costs and identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvement. Monitor delivery performance, including delays, trip completion, and POD status. Support the preparation and processing of sales invoices and delivery-related documents, where required. Work closely with external transporters and service providers when required. Develop and maintain Excel-based trackers and dashboards for fleet and logistics KPIs. Support management with logistics data analysis, forecasting, and operational reports. Ensure compliance with company policies, safety requirements, and local transportation regulations. Qualifications & Requirements Minimum 3 years relevant experience in Kuwait / GCC Logistics, Fleet Management, Transportation Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, and data analysis. Experience with ERP, WMS, TMS, fleet management systems, or other logistics software. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to prepare and interpret logistics and fleet performance reports.. Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple operational priorities. Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Good command of English; Arabic is an advantage.

results.title: Senior Director – Autonomous Mobility

Strong experience engaging with government and regulatory stakeholders. Experience with public-private partnerships or government-led innovation programs is highly desirable. Strong knowledge of the mobility and CEP sectors, including smart cities, urban logistics, last-mile delivery economics, and operating models. Practical understanding of autonomous vehicle technologies, deployment models, safety requirements, and operational considerations. Develop scalable commercial models for autonomous mobility solutions across public roads, campuses, private developments, and other relevant environments. Own the business P&L, including revenue growth, cost management, investment planning, and overall financial performance. Lead go-to-market strategy, pricing, customer acquisition, commercial pipeline development, and strategic partnerships. We specialize in providing transportation services to our Red Sea destination. results.title: Fleet Lead.E - Commerce - Fulfillment Operations
results.description: Job Description Job Purpose The Fleet Lead is responsible for overseeing and managing the company's delivery fleet to ensure the efficient and timely transportation of goods. This role focuses on ensuring that the fleet operates safely, cost-effectively, and in compliance with all legal and company requirements. The Fleet Lead also monitors the performance of drivers, manages vehicle maintenance schedules, and implements strategies to optimize fleet operations. Key Accountabilities Fleet Management: Oversee the day-to-day operations of the fleet, including vehicle allocation, scheduling, and tracking to ensure timely deliveries. Driver Supervision: Lead and supervise a team of drivers, ensuring they follow company policies, safety standards, and performance expectations. Vehicle Maintenance: Coordinate regular maintenance and repairs of the fleet to ensure vehicles are roadworthy and safe, minimizing downtime and operational disruptions. Fleet Performance Monitoring: Track fleet performance metrics such as fuel efficiency, delivery times, and maintenance costs, and take action to improve fleet performance and reduce costs. Safety & Compliance: Ensure that all fleet operations comply with legal regulations, safety protocols, and company policies. Conduct regular safety checks and driver training. Route Optimization: Collaborate with the logistics team to optimize delivery routes, reduce fuel consumption, and increase efficiency in delivery times. Budget & Cost Control: Manage the fleet budget, ensuring cost-effective operations while maintaining high service standards. Identify areas for cost savings and operational improvements. Vendor & Supplier Relations: Manage relationships with external vendors, including vehicle leasing companies, fuel suppliers, and maintenance service providers to ensure high-quality service and competitive pricing. Reporting & Documentation: Maintain accurate records of vehicle inspections, repairs, fuel usage, and driver performance. Prepare reports on fleet performance for management review. Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Knowledge of vehicle maintenance and fleet management best practices. Ability to manage budgets and control costs. Familiarity with fleet management software and tracking tools

results.title: Head of Logistics Assets (Leasing, Development, & Asset Management)
results.description: Head of Logistics Assets (Leasing, Development, & Asset Management) Riyadh, Saudi Arabia We are partnering with a leading industrial real estate investment and development platform that is expanding its presence in Saudi Arabia. The business develops, owns and operates industrial parks, logistics warehouses and built-to-suit facilities, with a long-term ownership strategy focused on creating high-quality logistics assets. As part of its continued growth, the firm is seeking a Head of Logistics to lead its logistics warehouse platform across the Kingdom. Key Responsibilities: Define the logistics warehouse product strategy based on market demand and customer requirements. Partner with development and engineering teams to ensure assets meet commercial and leasing requirements. Monitor market trends, rental levels, supply dynamics and customer demand to support business strategy. Develop relationships with logistics operators, 3PLs, e-commerce businesses, retailers and brokerage networks. Drive leasing activity, occupancy and rental income across the portfolio. Originate and negotiate build-to-suit opportunities and pre-leasing agreements with key occupiers. Lead lease negotiations, including commercial terms, incentives and renewals. Oversee asset performance, including occupancy, NOI, budgets and long-term value creation. Manage external property management and facilities management providers to maintain operational excellence. Build and lead the logistics asset management, leasing and customer development team as the business grows. Requirements: Bachelor's degree in Real Estate, Business, Finance or a related discipline. 8+ years' experience within logistics or industrial real estate. Strong background across leasing, customer development and asset management. Deep understanding of logistics warehouse products and what drives successful leasing performance. Established network within the Saudi logistics market, including 3PLs, e-commerce operators, retailers and industry stakeholders. Excellent commercial negotiation and relationship management skills. Experience leading or mentoring teams. Fluent in both Arabic and English.

Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Job Description In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible. Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented Interface & Logistics Manager to join our team! In this role you will get to lead and manage all technical and operational interfaces between multiple parties while planning and controlling logistics to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of major infrastructure works. Position Overview: The Interface & Logistics Manager will lead and manage all technical and operational interfaces between multiple contractors, consultants, stakeholders, and authorities on the project, while planning and controlling logistics to ensure safe, efficient and timely delivery of works. The role is a key part of Parsons’ PMC team, acting as a central coordination point to avoid scope gaps, conflicts and delays across all packages. What You'll Be Doing Interface Management Developing, implementing, and maintaining the Project Interface Management Plan in alignment with Parsons PMC procedures and client requirements. Establishing and managing interface tools including Interface Register, Interface Matrix, Scope Delineation and Interface Agreement Forms for all contracts and disciplines. Identifying, categorizing, and tracking all interface points between infrastructure packages (roads, utilities, buildings, transportation, ITS, etc.) and external stakeholders (authorities, operators, third parties). Coordinating and chairing regular interface coordination meetings between contractors, consultants, and client, ensuring timely resolution of interface issues and clear action ownership. Defining and implementing escalation paths for interface conflicts, including technical and contractual escalation to Parsons management and client leadership when required. Reviewing and validating contractors’ interface-related drawings, method statements, and programmes to ensure alignment at tie-in points, corridors, and shared assets. Managing interface dependencies and constraints to minimize rework, claims, and delays, ensuring full alignment between design, construction, testing, and commissioning activities. Supporting change management and claims avoidance by providing interface impact assessments and recommendations to Parsons PMC and the client. Logistics Management Developing and overseeing the Project Logistics Plan covering materials delivery, site access, laydown areas, traffic management, temporary facilities, and construction sequencing. Coordinating logistics across multiple contractors to optimize use of corridors, access roads, storage areas, and cranes/equipment, avoiding conflicts and unsafe conditions. Working with contractors to plan and schedule material deliveries, heavy transport, and critical lifts, ensuring compliance with local authority regulations and project HSSE requirements. Monitoring and managing logistics KPIs (delivery performance, congestion, utilization, etc.) using PMIS and other tools and proposing corrective actions where needed. Ensuring integration of logistics plans with interface constraints, utility diversions, and phased handovers, particularly in live or sensitive operational environments. Stakeholder & Authority Coordination Acting as a focal point for coordination with relevant authorities and stakeholders (e.g. municipal entities, utility providers, transport authorities, operators), especially at physical and operational interface points. Supporting approvals and permits related to interfaces and logistics (road closures, diversions, utility connections, working windows, etc.). Ensuring clear communication of interface requirements to all stakeholders, including constraints affecting operations, safety, and public impact. PMIS, Reporting & Documentation Maintaining interface and logistics data in the project PMIS (e.g. Aconex or equivalent), ensuring accurate and up-to-date records, action tracking, and document control. Preparing periodic interface and logistics status reports, dashboards, and KPIs for Parsons PMC and client management. Recording, maintaining, and updating interface agreements, minutes of meetings, decisions, and approvals to ensure traceability and auditability. HSSE & Compliance Ensuring all interface and logistics activities comply with project HSSE requirements, local regulations, and Parsons PMC procedures. Identifying and helping mitigate interface-related HSSE risks (e.g. conflicting work fronts, traffic management, simultaneous operations, live utilities). Promoting a proactive safety culture among contractors in relation to logistics, access, and interfaces. What Required Skills You'll Bring Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical, or related discipline). More than 15 years of experience in large-scale infrastructure, utilities, or industrial projects; experience in KSA/GCC is highly preferred. Proven experience in interface management and logistics coordination on major multi-contractor projects; PMC experience is an advantage. Strong understanding of infrastructure utilities (potable/fire water, irrigation, MV/LV, telecom, drainage, GRP, etc.) and their coordination in shared corridors. Demonstrated capability in preparing and managing interface documentation and logistics plans. Experience with PMIS platforms (e.g. Aconex) and strong reporting/documentation skills. Familiarity with relevant KSA standards, authority requirements, and permitting processes. What Desired Skills You'll Bring Excellent coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Strong problem-solving and conflict resolution abilities. Ability to manage multiple interfaces and priorities under time and schedule pressure. High level of organization and attention to detail. Fluency in English; Arabic proficiency is an advantage. results.title: Manager Logistics Performance
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Role Summary This role owns the commercial and performance engine behind talabat UAE's operations. You'll be the person who understands how the business actually ticks, where margin is made or lost, which levers move the numbers, and what trade-offs leadership is really weighing. You'll own the operational commercials and KPI performance, drive the optimization work that improves efficiency and experience, and turn analysis into decisions. It's a role for someone equally comfortable in a model and in a room full of directors, someone who can read the data and stand their ground on what it means . What's on your plate? Commercial & P&L Ownership for Operations Own the commercials behind UAE operations, cost-per-order, rider cost, and the efficiency metrics that drive the operational P&L. Track budget vs. actuals, protect riders and 3pls earnings, and give leadership clear, data-backed trade-offs between cost, growth, and customer experience. You're the person who can explain why the numbers moved, not just that they did. Performance Management Own the UAE operational KPI stack, from forecast to actuals. Anticipate performance gaps before they hit the P&L and drive the interventions that close them. Run the reporting and executive reviews that keep leadership decision-ready. Operational Optimization Drive the optimization agenda across the network: rider economics and staffing efficiency, vendor and coverage performance, area-level improvements. Find where the operation leaks cost or time, size the opportunity, and lead the fix, balancing efficiency against rider earnings and customer experience. Data, Modeling & Insight Be genuinely good with data, able to interrogate complex models, understand what's driving them, and pressure-test assumptions rather than take outputs at face value. Build the analyses and dashboards that make decisions faster, and translate complexity into a clear "so what." SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau are a strong plus; the non-negotiable is analytical judgment. Strategic Projects & Senior Stakeholder Leadership Lead cross-functional, high-impact projects that shape UAE operations. Build the business case, run the pilot, scale what works. Throughout, work directly with senior leadership, and hold your own with directors and VPs, defending a recommendation with evidence and staying credible under challenge. What you own vs. influence: You own the operational commercials, the performance KPI stack, and the delivery of your optimization projects. You influence the ops, commercial, and product teams whose execution moves those numbers, through insight, credibility, and stakeholder trust rather than direct authority. Qualifications What did we order? At least 4 years in operations, commercial, strategy, or consulting, ideally in a marketplace, logistics, or Q-commerce environment. Commercial instinct: you understand how a business makes money and which levers actually move it. Strong data literacy, comfortable working with complex data and models, interrogating assumptions, and drawing the right conclusion. You don't need to be handed the answer. Executive presence: able to engage, challenge, and stand your ground with senior stakeholders including directors and VPs. Financial modeling and P&L fluency, you can read a model, break it, and explain it. SQL (BigQuery) and Looker/Tableau a strong plus, not a requirement. Bias for ownership and follow-through, you close the loop rather than hand off the problem. Readiness to grow into people leadership (1–2 reports over time).
